Jev 是 TypeSafe AI 的「System One」模型：又快又便宜，: Jev is TypeSafe AI’s “System One” model: fast and cheap, good at multiple-choice style judgements such as which course a source belongs to or whether a question has a flaw. All of it is off by default; what it returns is only a reference signal, it never decides for you, and when it is wrong or unavailable everything works as before.

查看服务商的隐私与数据说明: Read the provider’s privacy and data notes
我已阅读以上说明，同意把这些内容发送到 Jev（TypeSafe 云端）: I have read the notes above and agree to send this content to Jev (TypeSafe’s cloud)
只发送你打开的功能所需的内容：资料的标题和开头的一小段节选、课程名、题目文字。不: Only what the features you switch on need is sent: a source’s title and a short excerpt from its start, course names, and question text. The whole library is never uploaded, and content is sent only when you use the feature.
发送到 TypeSafe AI 的云端服务（api.typesafe.ai），不: It goes to TypeSafe AI’s cloud service (api.typesafe.ai), not through your study model.
服务商在隐私政策里承诺不会用用户数据训练模型。普通账号的数据会保留多久，文档里没: The provider’s privacy policy commits not to train models on user data. How long a normal account’s data is retained is not documented (the provider only states that enterprise customers can get zero data retention), so assume what you send may be kept for some time.
免费额度、价格和速率限制以服务商为准；这里不显示价格，只统计用掉的 token。: Free tier, prices and rate limits are the provider’s to state; no price is shown here, only the tokens used.
这是实验功能，效果没有经过验证。Jev 主要针对英文优化，对中文的支持较弱；它给: This is an experiment and its quality has not been verified. Jev is mainly optimised for English and supports Chinese less well; what it returns is only a reference signal, and it never changes your materials or questions by itself. When it errors or is unavailable, everything works as before.
还没有调用过 Jev。: Jev has not been called yet.
Jev 的 token 与学习模型的用量分开统计；这里只显示 token 数，不: Jev’s tokens are counted separately from the study model’s; only token counts are shown here, never a price.

在「资料 › 整理课程归属」里多一个「Jev 建议」按钮，给出每门课的概率；把握: Adds a “Jev suggestion” button under Sources › Organize courses that shows a probability per course; it fills a course in only when it is confident enough, and you still press Apply.
出题时，在独立复审之前先让 Jev 粗筛每道题（题干是否泄露答案、脱离资料能否看: When questions are written, Jev screens each one before the independent review (does the stem give the answer away, can it be understood without the source, …); clearly flawed ones are rewritten once first. 判断目录条目是章节标题、小节标签、页眉页脚还是其他。接口已就绪，阅读器接入后才会: Classifies outline entries as chapter titles, section labels, headers or footers, or other. The interface is ready; it takes effect once the reader uses it.
